name: invented interview added to make a vague line specific
why: The most-starred humanizer was reported to add a made-up newspaper interview when told to be specific.
before: The founder has spoken about the early days of the company.
after: In a 2019 interview with the New York Times, the founder said the company nearly ran out of money.

name: list of three trimmed, dropping a real item
why: A rule against lists of three can delete a real claim.
before: The trial cut costs in Leeds, Bradford and Hull, with Hull seeing the largest fall.
after: The trial cut costs in Leeds and Bradford.

name: hedge stripped as filler
why: Words of doubt are part of the claim.
before: The drug may reduce symptoms in some patients.
after: The drug reduces symptoms in patients.

name: suggests becomes demonstrates
why: Reported by students as a way humanizers change a scientific claim.
before: The data suggests a link between sleep and memory.
after: The data demonstrates a link between sleep and memory.

name: about dropped from a figure
why: An estimate must stay an estimate.

name: quotation smoothed
why: Quoted words stay word for word.
before: She said "the early signs are encouraging but we need another year of data".
after: She said "the early signs are encouraging, though more data is needed".

name: number written as a word is the same number
why: A faithful rewrite must not be failed for style.
before: The pilot ran in 12 clinics and cut waits by 15%.
after: The pilot ran in twelve clinics and cut waits by 15 percent.

name: not-just-but removed without changing the meaning
why: The commonest honest edit must not trip the negation check.
before: Tidepool is not just a sync tool, but a backup tool. It was released on 5 May 2026.
after: Tidepool is a sync tool and a backup tool. It was released on 5 May 2026.

name: heading changed from title case to sentence case
why: Capital letters in a heading are styling, not names.
before:
# Key Findings Of The Review

The review by Hartwell Labs covered 40 sites.
after:
# Key findings of the review

Hartwell Labs reviewed 40 sites.

name: the month of May is not a word of doubt
why: May the month and may the hedge must not be confused.
before: The launch is in May 2026. It may slip.
after: The launch, planned for May 2026, may slip.

name: unchanged text passes
why: Leaving good text alone is a valid result.
before: We met on Tuesday at 10:30 and agreed three actions.
after: We met on Tuesday at 10:30 and agreed three actions.
